sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another.
Read

God led His people out of Egypt, and He gave His law to the people. These laws also included the 10 Commandments. God wanted His people to be holy and to fellowship with him. He did not want them to be like the other nations.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read

After the people received God’s law, they had to continue their journey to the land that had been promised to Abraham. But they disobeyed God’s commands and could not enter the Promised Land. Because they disobeyed God’s commands, God caused the Israelites to wander the desert until those who had disobeyed died. Even Moses died. Then, Joshua became the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua led the people across the Jordan River into the Promised Land. Each family was given part of the land as their inheritance just as God had promised to Abraham.
Read
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Joshua 1:1–9
Joshua 3:7–17
Read

These verses teach us that God's grace endures through our failures. Israel disobeyed God repeatedly, yet God didn’t abandon them. He kept leading them and carrying them forward. God's grace doesn’t depend on our perfection; it’s a love that refuses to let us go. This same grace leads us to God's rest. Just as God led Israel across the Jordan into the promised land, so He leads us out of our wandering to Himself. The One who leads us there is Jesus Christ, who walks with us through our wandering and brings us home to God.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Do
Has your heart been wandering; searching for truth or peace? Ask Jesus to show you the truth and give you his peace.
Ask
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
